title: Hot Cocoa Mix

adjustment.analysis: No events, promotions, or price changes in the target week. The baseline already reflects recent trends and seasonal noise. Past back-to-school weeks show no consistent uplift (noise-adjusted x1.0). Promotion effects are muted (noise-adjusted x1.0) and post-promo dips are normal (x0.85). No evidence of demand shift.
